experiment: E4 Part B optimisation ladder (GR00T, cumulative)
precision: per rung: raw/rows/<rung>_N<N>.json rung_desc.precision_flags and param_dtype_bytes
rung: per row: ae_compile, ae_graphs, all_compile_autotune, eager_fp32, eager_tf32, llm_compile, llm_graphs, vis_compile, vis_graphs, vlm_compile, vlm_graphs
variant: n/a: ladder rungs as defined in bench/rungs.py
num_denoise_steps: 4 (extra N per rung for the slope: by_N in the row files)
n_warmup: >= 20 and until no new graph for 5 inferences (warmup_iters per row)
command: bash bench/queues/t005_ladders.sh 20261022  (groot_n17: cd /tmp; ~/venvs/groot17/bin/python <repo>/bench/opt_ladder.py --model groot_n17 --out <repo>/results/20261022_E4d_groot_n17_ladder --rungs <11 GR00T rungs> --slope-steps 2,6 --slope-rungs all; paused at rung boundaries for T005 diagnostics)
notes: One process per rung; regions after compilation (bench/regions.py); warm-up until torch._dynamo's unique_graphs counter is stable; graphs_compiled_during_timed must be 0. Every timed block began in the normal memory-path state (T003). Equivalence in equivalence.csv.
